instruction.name: xvshuf.w
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, shuffle 32-bit elements from `b` and `c` using the low 3 bits of the indices from the corresponding lane of `a`, and save the result to `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvshuf.w $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvshuf.w $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvshuf.w $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvshuf.w $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvshuf.w $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvshuf.w $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvshuf.w $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvshuf.w $xr7, $xr15, $xr23
